card.name: Capitalized hypersensitivity warning headings
card.fires_on: The piece "PER" in the all-caps boxed warning heading "HYPERSENSITIVITY REACTIONS INCLUDING ANAPHYLAXIS", right after a bracketed see Warnings and Precautions reference. It also fires on a few other words inside all-caps warning text.

modes.description: Linking words or word endings in all-caps warnings about anaphylaxis treatment or esophageal distress.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are language names like French and English, which does not fit the context, so no clear output effect.
